command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
echo "== racon: one round, real reads =="
racon --version
T0=$(date +%s)
racon -t 2 reads.fastq ov.paf draft.fa > polished-racon.fa 2> racon.log
RC=$?; T1=$(date +%s)
echo "racon_rc\t$RC"
test "$RC" = "0" || { tail -20 racon.log; exit 1; }
PL=$(awk '!/^>/{n+=length($0)} END{print n}' polished-racon.fa)
NSEQ=$(grep -c '^>' polished-racon.fa)
echo "racon_wall_s\t$(( T1 - T0 ))"
echo "racon_bp\t$PL"
echo "racon_seqs\t$NSEQ"
test "$NSEQ" = "1" || { echo "racon emitted $NSEQ sequences, expected 1"; exit 1; }
# A polished sequence near the truth's length is necessary but nowhere near sufficient; the
# edit distance in task 3 is the real check. This only catches a collapsed or doubled output.
test "$PL" -gt 6000 -a "$PL" -lt 6700 || { echo "racon output $PL bp is not plausible for a 6361 bp plasmid"; exit 1; }
{ printf 'racon_version\t%s\n' "$(racon --version)"
  printf 'racon_bp\t%s\nracon_seqs\t%s\nracon_wall_s\t%s\n' "$PL" "$NSEQ" "$(( T1 - T0 ))"; } > racon-diag.txt
echo "RACON OK"
